title: House of Memories
lyrics:
[00:15.29]If you're a lover, you should know
[00:17.41]The lonely moments just get lonelier
[00:20.18]The longer you're in love
[00:22.38]Than if you were alone
[00:24.10]Memories turn into daydreams
[00:27.76]Become a taboo
[00:32.70]I don't want to be afraid
[00:35.46]The deeper that I go
[00:37.44]It takes my breath away
[00:39.57]Soft hearts, electric souls
[00:41.71]Heart to heart and eyes to eyes
[00:45.57]Is this taboo?
[00:49.71]Baby, we built this house on memories
[00:54.66]Take my picture now, shake it till you see it
[00:58.65]And when your fantasies become your legacy
[01:02.79]Promise me a place in your house of memories
[01:16.23]I think of you from time to time
[01:18.80]More than I thought I would
[01:21.02]You were just too kind
[01:23.26]And I was too young to know
[01:25.18]That's all that really matters
[01:29.17]I was a fool
[01:33.29]Baby, we built this house on memories
[01:38.29]Take my picture now, shake it till you see it
[01:42.27]And when your fantasies become your legacy
[01:46.44]Promise me a place in your house of memories
[02:10.13]Those thoughts of past lovers, they'll always haunt me
[02:15.33]I wish I could believe you'd never wrong me
[02:20.42]Then will you remember me in the same way
[02:26.36]As I remember you?
[02:30.51]Baby, we built this house on memories
[02:36.09]Take my picture now, shake it till you see it
[02:40.43]And when your fantasies become your legacy
[02:44.82]Promise me a place
[02:49.06]Baby, we built this house on memories
[02:54.06]Take my picture now, shake it till you see it
[02:57.99]And when your fantasies become your legacy
[03:02.18]Promise me a place in your house of memories
[03:13.72]In your house of memories
[03:19.51]Promise me a place
